About

Designing with Passion

Sadia Marwa is a fashion designer who turns fabric, colour and imagination into wearable art. Every piece is created with care, from the first sketch to the final stitch, with a focus on quality and fit.

Together with her husband, Abdul Rehman, she is building a brand rooted in creativity, craftsmanship and customer trust.
